scenarios.name: server-stateless
scenarios.behavior: Exercise per-request metadata, exact modern headers, discover, unknown-method errors, missing-client-capability errors, streaming/log opt-in, subscriptions acknowledgments/filtering, and list-change notifications. Provide the diagnostic tools listed here.

scenarios.name: completion-complete
scenarios.behavior: Complete arg1 of test_prompt_with_arguments for value par; declare completions. Empty completion values are supported by the referee.

scenarios.name: tools-list
scenarios.behavior: Advertise deterministic ordered tool definitions with name, description, and valid object inputSchema.

scenarios.name: tools-call-simple-text
scenarios.behavior: Return nonempty text content.

scenarios.name: tools-call-image
scenarios.behavior: Return base64 PNG image content, preferably a minimal valid fixture image.

scenarios.name: tools-call-audio
scenarios.behavior: Return base64 WAV audio content.

scenarios.name: tools-call-embedded-resource
scenarios.behavior: Return embedded text resource at test://embedded-resource.

scenarios.name: tools-call-mixed-content
scenarios.behavior: Return text, image, and embedded JSON resource in one result.

scenarios.name: tools-call-error
scenarios.behavior: Raise an application tool error; translate it to a result with isError=true and text content.

scenarios.name: tools-call-with-progress
scenarios.behavior: With request progressToken emit progress 0, 50, 100 with total 100, approximately 50ms apart, then final text. Without token emit no progress.

scenarios.name: server-sse-multiple-streams
scenarios.behavior: Accept concurrent POST requests; each response belongs to its own request and may use JSON or its own SSE stream. Revision selection avoids stateful sessions.

scenarios.name: resources-list
scenarios.behavior: List direct resources separately from templates; expose name, URI and description.

scenarios.name: resources-read-text
scenarios.behavior: Read test://static-text as text/plain with nonempty text.

scenarios.name: resources-read-binary
scenarios.behavior: Read test://static-binary as image/png with base64 blob.

scenarios.name: resources-templates-read
scenarios.behavior: Expand test://template/{id}/data; read id=123 and return JSON text containing id, templateTest=true, and data.

scenarios.name: sep-2164-resource-not-found
scenarios.behavior: Unknown URI returns -32602 with error.data.uri; never return empty contents as success.

scenarios.name: prompts-list
scenarios.behavior: List named prompts with descriptions and declared arguments.

scenarios.name: prompts-get-simple
scenarios.behavior: Return at least one user text message.

scenarios.name: prompts-get-with-args
scenarios.behavior: Require arg1 and arg2 string arguments and include their values in prompt text.

scenarios.name: prompts-get-embedded-resource
scenarios.behavior: Use resourceUri argument for embedded text resource plus a user text message.

scenarios.name: prompts-get-with-image
scenarios.behavior: Return a user PNG image message and user text message.

scenarios.name: dns-rebinding-protection
scenarios.behavior: Run on a loopback HTTP URL. Reject hostile Host/Origin with HTTP 4xx; accept configured loopback origins. No browser CORS assumption.

scenarios.name: caching
scenarios.behavior: Include integer ttlMs >= 0 and cacheScope public/private on all five list/read result shapes.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-basic-elicitation
scenarios.behavior: First round request elicitation/create under inputRequests.user_name with required string name. Retry consumes inputResponses.user_name; complete using received name.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-basic-sampling
scenarios.behavior: First round request sampling/createMessage under capital_question, maxTokens=100. Retry completes using its response text.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-basic-list-roots
scenarios.behavior: First round request roots/list under client_roots. Retry completes using supplied roots.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-request-state
scenarios.behavior: Issue elicitation/create under confirm with required boolean ok plus opaque requestState. Validate echoed state and include state-ok in final text.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-multiple-input-requests
scenarios.behavior: Request user_name elicitation, greeting sampling, and client_roots roots/list together plus opaque state. Complete after all responses return.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-multi-round
scenarios.behavior: Round 1 elicitation step1 asks string name. Round 2 elicitation step2 asks string color with changed opaque state. Round 3 completes.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-missing-input-response
scenarios.behavior: Missing/wrong response keys re-request missing user_name information; do not treat as successful completion.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-non-tool-request
scenarios.behavior: prompts/get may return input_required asking user_context elicitation for string context, then a complete GetPromptResult.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-result-type
scenarios.behavior: InputRequiredResult explicitly includes resultType=input_required.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-unsupported-methods
scenarios.behavior: Never return input_required on methods outside tools/call, resources/read, prompts/get. Tasks are not enabled.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-tampered-state
scenarios.behavior: Issue integrity-protected state then reject modified state with JSON-RPC invalid-params error; never keep a continuation session.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-capability-check
scenarios.behavior: Emit input requests only for capabilities supplied in request metadata. Sampling-only client must never receive elicitation input request.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-ignore-extra-params
scenarios.behavior: Ignore unrecognized extra input-response keys when the requested user_name response is valid.

scenarios.name: input-required-result-validate-input
scenarios.behavior: Malformed inputResponses yields a protocol error or new input_required result, never successful completion.
